Worst meal of the whole trip in Vietnam
Dec 2019
We came here for dinner around 7pm, the restaurant was completely empty, however, it didn't look too empty as there were like 20 waiters walking around. Once we sat, like 3-4 waiters stood around us waiting for us to order, it felt really weird having so many people standing next us for no reason. Once we were ready to order we realised that none of the staff spoke English, not even a word! We ended up ordering chicken, stir-fried rice and noodles with seafood. All the dishes in the menu were very expensive comparing to other restaurants in Vietnam. When the food arrived it looked ok, however, once we started eating we became extremely disappointed. There were a few prawns and squid pieces on a stir-fry, but after they were eaten it was pretty much plain rice that was left - no veg, egg or anything, the whole meal was very bland and not enjoyable. The seafood noodles were very dry and didn't have much flavour, as for the chicken - it was mainly bones, there was not much meat at all! The rice was 165,000 VND, noodles 205,000 VND and the chicken - 290,000 VND, a total rip-off for what we received! The staff kept on coming and cleaning the table with a dirty cloth throughout the dinner, which we find a bit irritating. We left the restaurant around 8pm and it was still completely empty, I guess not for a reason. At the end this ended up being one of the most expensive and worst meals of our two week trip in Vietnam. My experience really made me question the credibility of the reviews below.

Good food
Feb 2019 • Friends
We end up in this restaurant as we were walking in the city and it looked good.
The service was very good, they have plenty waitress however none of them spoke english so we had to use google translate. The menus are in english so that make it easyer.
The food was very good. I ordered seafood noodles and it was delicious. My friend is vegetarian so for him was difficult as they didnt have much choises not even white plain rise. However he enjoyed the vegetables.
I tryed the beer and it was quite nice.
The place became quite crowded and noisy later on, it is an open restaurant looking to one of the main roads so the noise from the traffic was quite high, it was really difficult to have a conversation.

In general a good place to try if you are in Da Nang.

Fantastic dinner
Jun 2018 • Family
Stumbled upon this restaurant. We were not disappointed! The hotel called to reserve a table before the 9pm dragon fire show. We had to come earlier than we wanted as they said it was very busy.
Football was showing there were a lot of people eating and drinking. Great atmosphere. We were greeted by the manager and had a few waitresses who kept on replenishing beers and ice to keep them cool. 
The food was outstanding, we wanted sashimi they said they’d sold out but went to purchase some for us. Our meals were flavoursome, out of the 10 dishes there were none we didn’t enjoy.
The manager mentioned that not many tourists came to the restaurant only locals.
I think it is a must visit while in Denang.
